title: Production UI functionality audit

methodology: Grepped src/ for the stale/launch-copy phrase set across banker/admin/crm/portfolio/workflow/workspaces/deals surfaces. Each finding is classified by who sees it (bank-facing vs admin-only) and a disposition.
